import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    start_hist = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=365)

    # --- Only data that already existed at seed_time ---
    # order_items: event time = ts (purchase moment)
    oi_hist = db["order_items"][
        (db["order_items"]["ts"] >= start_hist) &
        (db["order_items"]["ts"] < seed_time)
    ].copy()

    if oi_hist.empty:
        result = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))
        result["has_history"] = 0.0
        return result.astype(np.float64)

    # orders: keep only orders purchased before seed_time
    orders = db["orders"][
        (db["orders"]["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time)
    ][[
        "order_id", "order_status",
        "order_purchase_timestamp",
        "order_delivered_customer_date",
        "order_estimated_delivery_date"
    ]]

    oi_o = oi_hist.merge(orders, on="order_id", how="left")

    # Delivery info is only known if delivery happened before seed_time
    delivered_known = (
        oi_o["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna() &
        (oi_o["order_delivered_customer_date"] <= seed_time)
    )

    oi_o["delivery_delay_days"] = (
        oi_o["order_delivered_customer_date"]
        - oi_o["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)

    oi_o["delivery_time_days"] = (
        oi_o["order_delivered_customer_date"]
        - oi_o["order_purchase_timestamp"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)

    oi_o["is_delivered_known"] = delivered_known.astype(float)
    oi_o.loc[~delivered_known, "delivery_delay_days"] = np.nan
    oi_o.loc[~delivered_known, "delivery_time_days"] = np.nan
    # undelivered/canceled status flag (known at seed_time)
    oi_o["is_canceled_or_unavailable"] = (
        oi_o["order_status"].isin(["canceled", "unavailable"])
    ).astype(float)

    # reviews: only reviews created before seed_time
    reviews = db["reviews"][
        (db["reviews"]["review_creation_date"] < seed_time)
    ][["order_id", "review_score"]]
    # dedupe: one review per order (first one)
    reviews = reviews.sort_values("order_id").drop_duplicates("order_id")

    oi_r = oi_o.merge(reviews, on="order_id", how="left")
    oi_r["has_review"] = oi_r["review_score"].notna().astype(float)

    # payments: only payments made before seed_time
    pay = db["payments"][
        (db["payments"]["ts"] < seed_time)
    ]
    payments_agg = pay.groupby("order_id").agg(
        total_payment=("payment_value", "sum"),
        avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        frac_credit_card=("payment_type", lambda x: (x == "credit_card").mean()),
    ).reset_index()

    oi_f = oi_r.merge(payments_agg, on="order_id", how="left")

    g = oi_f.groupby("product_id")

    product_features = g.agg(
        total_units_sold=("order_item_id", "count"),
        n_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        n_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
        total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        max_price=("price", "max"),
        min_price=("min_price", "min") if False else ("price", "min"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        freight_ratio=("freight_value", lambda x: np.nan),  # placeholder
        avg_delivery_delay=("delivery_delay_days", "mean"),
        max_delivery_delay=("delivery_delay_days", "max"),
        avg_delivery_time=("delivery_time_days", "mean"),
        frac_delivered_known=("is_delivered_known", "mean"),
        frac_canceled=("is_canceled_or_unavailable", "mean"),
        avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        min_review_score=("review_score", "min"),
        frac_5star=("review_score", lambda x: (x == 5).mean()),
        frac_1star=("review_score", lambda x: (x == 1).mean()),
        has_review=("has_review", "mean"),
        avg_order_total=("total_payment", "mean"),
        avg_payment_installments=("avg_installments", "mean"),
        frac_credit_card_payments=("frac_credit_card", "mean"),
    )

    # freight ratio computed properly
    fr = oi_f.groupby("product_id").apply(
        lambda d: d["freight_value"].sum() / max(d["price"].sum(), 1e-9),
        include_groups=False
    )
    product_features["freight_ratio"] = fr

    # --- time-window features: last 30 / 90 days vs older ---
    def window_stats(days):
        w = oi_f[oi_f["ts"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=days)]
        wg = w.groupby("product_id").agg(
            units=("order_item_id", "count"),
            orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
            revenue=("price", "sum"),
        )
        return wg

    w30 = window_stats(30)
    w90 = window_stats(90)
    # second half of history (recency trend)
    mid = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=182)
    recent_half = oi_f[oi_f["ts"] >= mid].groupby("product_id")["order_item_id"].count()
    older_half = oi_f[oi_f["ts"] < mid].groupby("product_id")["order_item_id"].count()

    wf = product_features
    wf["units_30d"] = w30["units"].reindex(wf.index).fillna(0.0)
    wf["orders_30d"] = w30["orders"].reindex(wf.index).fillna(0.0)
    wf["revenue_30d"] = w30["revenue"].reindex(wf.index).fillna(0.0)
    wf["units_90d"] = w90["units"].reindex(wf.index).fillna(0.0)
    wf["revenue_90d"] = w90["revenue"].reindex(wf.index).fillna(0.0)
    wf["recent_half_units"] = recent_half.reindex(wf.index).fillna(0.0)
    wf["older_half_units"] = older_half.reindex(wf.index).fillna(0.0)
    wf["trend_ratio"] = wf["recent_half_units"] / (wf["older_half_units"] + 1.0)
    wf["days_since_last_sale"] = (
        seed_time - oi_f.groupby("product_id")["ts"].max()
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    wf["days_since_first_sale"] = (
        seed_time - oi_f.groupby("product_id")["ts"].min()
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    wf["has_history"] = 1.0

    wf = wf.drop(columns=["freight_ratio_placeholder"], errors="ignore")
    wf = wf.reset_index()

    result = pd.DataFrame({"product_id": list(entity_ids)}).merge(
        wf, on="product_id", how="left"
    )

    # fills for products without history / missing values
    for c in ["avg_review_score"]:
        result[c] = result[c].fillna(3.0)
    result["min_review_score"] = result["min_review_score"].fillna(3.0)
    for c in ["std_price", "avg_delivery_delay", "max_delivery_delay",
              "avg_delivery_time"]:
        result[c] = result[c].fillna(0.0)
    result = result.fillna(0.0)

    result = result.set_index("product_id").reindex(entity_ids)
    result = result.astype(np.float64)
    return result
